artworks.title: Mock Joust of War with Fixed Shields
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor over black chalk and leadpoint on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a jousting scene. A knight clad in red armor and mounted on a red-clad horse is engaging in a jousting match. The knight's lance strikes the opponent, who wears blue and yellow striped attire. The opponent is falling off their horse. The horses are well detailed, particularly their covers and armor. The background is plain. The style and appearance suggest a historical or retro illustration typical of medieval tournaments.

artworks.title: Mock Joust of War with Fixed Shields
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor over black chalk and leadpoint on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a jousting match between two armored figures on horseback. The image captures a moment in a joust, with two armored figures on horses clashing. One figure rides a black and white horse and is dressed in blue and white armor, with a feathered helmet. The other figure is in red and green drapery, having been unseated. The scene is framed by a simple line border, and the paper has a slightly aged appearance, suggesting the drawing could be from an earlier historical period. The fine lines and shading give a sense of movement to the image.

artworks.title: Mock Joust of War with Fixed Shields

artworks.title: Mock Joust of War with Fixed Shields

artworks.description: This is a drawing of a jousting scene between two armored horses. The drawing depicts two horses equipped for a joust. Both horses have intricate designs on their front legs and detailed armor. The lance of the horse on the right is raised, pointing toward the fallen horse. Some handwritten text is visible near the top right corner of the page.

artworks.title: Mock Joust of War with Fixed Shields

artworks.description: This is a drawing of two horses in a jousting scene. The description includes two horses clad in armor, one in red and white and the other in green and striped tones. The horses are in a dynamic action pose, suggesting movement and the impact of a joust. The armor, colorful horse draperies, and posture convey a sense of medieval tournament spectacle. The setting evokes themes of chivalry and medieval tournaments. The composition is framed by a simple border on a parchment-like background.

artworks.title: Mock Joust of War with Fixed Shields

artworks.description: This is a painting of a medieval jousting scene with two armored horses charging towards each other. Each horse has a lance, and there is a visible action of collision, with a lance being broken in mid-air. The scene suggests dynamic movement and an intense moment of impact. The background is plain, highlighting the focus on the duel itself and capturing a glimpse of medieval tournament life. This is in the style of medieval manuscript illustrations.

artworks.title: Mock Joust of War with Flying Shields

The scene includes broken lances scattered on the ground. The drawing has a traditional style symbolic of medieval or renaissance tournament imagery, contained within a border.

artworks.title: Mock Joust of War with Flying Shields

Both horses are elaborately draped in colorful cloth matching the rider's attire. Lances are pointed towards one another, capturing movement with the dynamic pose of the animals and scattered broken lance pieces. The background is simply detailed, emphasizing the jousting interaction.

artworks.title: Mock Joust of War with Flying Shields

The lances have fragmented upon impact, emphasizing the intensity of their encounter. The background is blank, focusing on the central action. The drawing is detailed, with attention to textures and shapes of the armor, horses, and weapons.

artworks.title: Mock Joust of War with Flying and Exploding Shields
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor over black chalk and leadpoint on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting showing two fallen knights and their horse in a chaotic scene. The image depicts the knights being dislodged from their horse. The horse is adorned with a red cloth. The knights wear green and yellow-striped armor, with their limbs in different positions. One knight is falling headfirst, while the other is upside down with legs in the air. Armor pieces and jousting equipment are scattered around, including a lance on the ground. The scene is comedic, with fragments of cloth and helmet plume suggesting a significant impact. The style is reminiscent of medieval or early modern illustrations that humorously depict jousting tournaments.

artworks.title: Mock Joust of War with Flying and Exploding Shields
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor over black chalk and leadpoint on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of two horses in a mock combat scene. The painting depicts two horses in elaborate armor entangled in a fall. One horse appears to be collapsing, with its hind legs raised in the air, while the other horse is leaning and almost toppling over. Various elements such as shields, helmets, and decorative bits seem to scatter around the scene, adding to the sense of chaotic movement. This is in the style of Honoré Daumier, known for his satirical touch in illustrative art. The overall composition of the image suggests a dynamic interpretation of medieval jousting.

artworks.title: Mock Joust of War with Flying and Exploding Shields

artworks.description: This is a drawing of two knights jousting on horseback. The scene depicts two armored knights engaging in a jousting match, each mounted on a horse. The knight on the left rides a white horse adorned in red, intricate patterned armor, and is seen striking the helmet off the other knight with a lance. The knight on the right is dressed in green and white striped armor, riding a brown horse, and their helmet is seen flying into pieces, indicating the moment of impact. The horses themselves wear matching decorative coverings. The style of the drawing suggests a historical or medieval theme, with attention to the details of the knights' armor and horse trappings. The background is plain, keeping the focus on the central action of the jousting match.

artworks.title: Mock Joust of War with Flying and Exploding Shields

artworks.title: Mock Joust of War with Flying and Exploding Shields

artworks.description: This is a painting of two knights in armor engaged in a jousting match. The scene illustrates a medieval joust, with both knights clad in ornate silver armor, depicted in full action as they collide. They ride horses, one with a golden covering and the other with a green and red striped cloth. The knights have been illustrated in a posture suggesting immediate impact; their lances are shattered, and pieces of armor appear to fly through the air. The surrounding elements, such as the scattered fragments, reinforce the moment of collision. This piece captures the excitement of a jousting tournament. It is in the style of a medieval manuscript or illustration.

artworks.title: Mock Joust of War with Flying and Exploding Shields

artworks.description: This is a painting of two knights in combat on horseback. The painting depicts a jousting scene with two knights clad in armor mid-action after being dismounted from their horses during a joust. One knight is in blue and silver armor with a piece of his shattered lance visible, while his horse has checkered green and yellow barding. The other knight, also in armor, holds a lance and rides a horse covered in a red cloth with a white cross emblem. The painting showcases the dynamic motion and dramatic upheaval of the jousting scene, providing a detailed look at knightly armor and horse attire. This painting is in the style of Albrecht Dürer.
